title: AI-LENS™ — ECBTAX — BEFORE P7
methodology: Observe the official ECBTAX web presence across independent AI systems.
Compare findability, official-domain selection, business-core survival, offer, audience, trust, operating model, digital/AI differentiation and evidence survival.
Preserve disagreements between models rather than collapsing them into a single synthetic answer.
P7 cross-AI merge is outside this report.
headline_finding: All four measured AI systems find ECBTAX and reach the official source, but they do not construct the same representation of the business.
conclusions: ECBTAX is findable by all four AI systems measured in this BEFORE state.
The official ECBTAX domain is selected by all four.
The reconstructed business representation diverges by model.
ChatGPT and Claude preserve only part of the measured commercial representation.
Gemini preserves the measured commercial representation more completely, with deep-proof loss.
Perplexity preserves the measured commercial representation strongly, but controlled deep proof was not measured.
P0–P6 does not prove recommendation behavior, competitor preference, technical root cause or remediation.
